# Copilot instructions

This repository is **Swarms**, a multi-agent orchestration framework for Python.

- Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for the quickstart and rules, and [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) for the full guide to `Agent` and every multi-agent structure.
- Import from the top level: `from swarms import Agent`.
- For current APIs, use the docs MCP server at `https://docs.swarms.world/mcp` or the plain-text docs at https://docs.swarms.world/llms.txt.
- Commit and PR titles use `[TYPE][Function/FileName][Short description]`. Format with `black --line-length 70`.
